evals.prompt: Define the design system for the docs site. The flows are in docs/design/flows.md and the component library ships its tokens in library/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md.
evals.expected_output: docs/design/design-system.md that mirrors every library token verbatim with light and dark values, asks the user for the typeface with a recommended answer before defining type roles, records contrast ratios computed with contrast.py for the text-on-background pairs the screens use, lists components with owner, variants, states and screens, and passes the lint with --library and --flows, whose report sits in docs/design/design-system.lint.json and whose summary line the reply quotes. No design-tool integration is available, so the reply says so and claims nothing built in a design file. The document is registered in the state file as a draft.
assertions: Every --plu- custom property of the library file appears in the document with the same light and dark values

assertions.text: The typeface is asked with a recommended answer, not chosen silently

assertions: Every contrast row has two ratios and a pass or fail
Every component row names at least one screen from the flows

assertions.text: docs/design/design-system.lint.json is among the files the run produced, its ok is true, its arguments include --library and --flows, and the reply quotes its summary line
The reply says no design-tool integration is available, and nothing is claimed as built in a design tool
docs/workbench/state.md lists docs/design/design-system.md in its Artifacts table with owner design-system and status draft

evals.prompt: Pick a nice palette for the app and create the variables.
evals.expected_output: No flows, brand or library exist; the skill writes nothing and replies with its stop template: tokens without screens are a palette, not a system, so design-ux-flows comes first; it asks for the brand colour and the typeface, or the artifact that holds them, each with a recommended answer that is not a value. It names no colour, palette or typeface of its own and does not offer to pick one if the user prefers.

assertions.text: No file under docs/design/ is among the files the run produced

The reply names no colour, palette or typeface of its own (no hex value, no colour name such as "indigo", no font family other than the system font stack) and does not offer to pick one if the user prefers

assertions: The reply names design-ux-flows as the step that comes first, because the flows are missing

assertions.text: The reply asks for the brand colour and the typeface, or the artifact that holds them, each with a recommended answer that is not a value

evals.prompt: Define the design system for the docs site from library/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md and the flows, and build it in our design file too: create the variables, the text styles and the components there.
evals.expected_output: The document is written as in case 1. Building in the design file needs a design-tool integration, and none is available here: the skill creates nothing, says so plainly, describes no variable, style or component as created in a file, records 'none available' under Design tool, and says that building in the file will first show the exact list of what is created and ask for an explicit yes once an integration is available.

assertions.text: The reply says no design-tool integration is available here and that nothing was created in a design file; neither the reply nor docs/design/design-system.md describes a variable, style or component as created in the file
The reply says that, once an integration is available, building in the design file will first show the exact list of what would be created and wait for an explicit yes

assertions: docs/design/design-system.md says under its design-tool part that no file was built because no integration is available
